_caveat: Peshitta consonants; vowels supplied by hand from Classical Syriac grammar; a later dialect than the Aramaic of AD 30; needs a Syriacist's check.

sayings.speaker: John (the Baptist)
sayings.english: I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness: make straight the way of the Lord.
sayings.syriac: ܐܢܐ ܩܠܐ ܕܩܪܐ ܒܡܕܒܪܐ ܕܐܫܘܘ ܐܘܪܚܗ ܕܡܪܝܐ
sayings.translit: ʾenā qālā d-qārē b-madbrā, d-ʾašwaw ʾurḥeh d-māryā
sayings.ipa: ʔe.ˈnaː ˈqaː.laː də.ˈqaː.reː bə.mað.bə.ˈraː | dʔaʃ.ˈwaw ʔur.ˈħeh də.ˈmaːr.jaː

sayings.speaker: John (the Baptist)
sayings.english: Behold the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world.
sayings.syriac: ܗܐ ܐܡܪܗ ܕܐܠܗܐ ܗܘ ܕܫܩܠ ܚܛܝܬܗ ܕܥܠܡܐ
sayings.translit: hā ʾemreh d-ʾalāhā, haw d-šāqel ḥṭīteh d-ʿālmā
sayings.ipa: ˈhaː ʔem.ˈreh da.ʔa.ˈlaː.haː | ˈhaw də.ˈʃaː.qel ħtˤiː.ˈθeh də.ˈʕaːl.maː

sayings.speaker: two disciples
sayings.english: Our master, where are you staying?

sayings.speaker: Jesus
sayings.english: You are Simon son of Jona; you shall be called Kepha.
sayings.syriac: ܐܢܬ ܗܘ ܫܡܥܘܢ ܒܪܗ ܕܝܘܢܐ ܐܢܬ ܬܬܩܪܐ ܟܐܦܐ
sayings.translit: ʾa(n)t-hū šemʿōn breh d-yawnā; ʾa(n)t tetqrē kēpā
sayings.ipa: ˈʔat huː ʃem.ˈʕoːn bə.ˈreh də.ˈjaw.naː | ˈʔat teθ.qə.ˈreː ˈkeː.faː
